channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from FMallSectionsDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Maryland judge blocks redistricting question from November ballot
item.description: An Anne Arundel County judge ruled Wednesday that Maryland Democrats' redistricting initiative cannot appear on the November ballot.

item.title: Court allows most of DOJ case against congresswoman over ICE clash
item.description: A federal appeals court on Wednesday permitted the Justice Department to proceed with most charges against Rep. LaMonica McIver.

item.title: Aging gracefully like Dolly Parton
item.description: Though not a devoted fan, the author admires Dolly Parton's approach to aging, citing her song '9 to 5' as a favorite.

item.title: Former AGs criticize D.C. Bar's 'disciplinary jihad' against Jeff Clark
item.description: A group of former attorneys general condemned the D.C. Bar's aggressive disciplinary action against former Trump DOJ official Jeff Clark.
